issues.description: The problem statement instructs the student to load the pixel value into ECX at the third TODO (explicitly 'mov ecx, [esi]'), but the provided solution loads the pixel into EAX ('mov eax, [esi]'). This register choice is referred to in the instructions and affects the expected register contents used later in main for printing. The mismatch between the described register (ECX) and the solution's use of EAX can confuse students about which register should hold the pixel value and which register they must preserve/restore.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register usage consistent between statement, template and solution. Either update the problem statement to instruct reading the pixel into EAX (e.g. replace 'mov ecx, [esi]' with 'mov eax, [esi]') or change the solution and any subsequent code in main to use ECX for the loaded pixel (replace 'mov eax, [esi]' with 'mov ecx, [esi]' and adjust the printf argument order accordingly).
